text: QREC has been the title sponsor of the Qatar Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe since 2008, alongside 14 other French Group races and the Qatar Arabian World Cup (since 2014); the 2026 Arc (3-4 October 2026, ParisLongchamp) carries a EUR 5 million purse, and QREC operates on the Qatari state domain qrec.gov.qa.
short: QREC title sponsor of the Arc since 2008 (EUR 5m race)
